headline: Shop Freezers Across Multiple European Countries Hit by Cyber-Attack
summary: A suspected cyber-attack hit IT systems, causing temperatures in shop freezers to rise across Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden, and other European countries, affecting retailers such as Ahold Delhaize, Colruyt, ICA, and Coop.
why: Cybersecurity incidents targeting major retail supply chains and store infrastructure can disrupt operations and result in inventory losses.

impacts.name: Ahold Delhaize
impacts.why: System disruptions and freezer temperature spikes can lead to inventory spoilage and operational setbacks for retail grocers.
